## Triage: audit · p2 · `domain:server` · confirmed · 2026-11-08T07:53Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- The one-time-token hand-off route (`GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff`) is mounted only on AuthPlugin's own server. A host that forwards `/api/v1/auth/*` to a kernel's `AuthManager` cannot answer it, because the token has to be minted inside the module's challenge scope. The ask is one exported `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff`, and AuthPlugin's own route calls the same export, so one implementation serves both.
- The filer's p2 and lane (`plugin-auth`) are confirmed. Business reach: on a hosted environment, a person cannot sign into the mobile app with Google. The consumers are cloud#3549 and objectstack-ai/mobile#148. `pm:queue`.
